sentences.Det kan være mange kulturelle forskjelle: There can be many cultural differences between different places in Norway.
sentences.Det er derfor ikke lett å si hva som er: So it isn't easy to say what is "typically Norwegian".
sentences.I dag bor det dessuten mennesker fra ove: Besides, people from over 200 different countries live in Norway today.

sentences.Men hva betyr det å være «norsk» i dag?: But what does it mean to be "Norwegian" today?
